blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) answer from two sources of evidence that can each fail: the retrieved text can be wrong or noisy, and the image can be degraded or contradicted. We introduce GIB-200K, 200,000 image-question items built from COCO and Visual Genome, each expanded into controlled stress conditions: hard-negative retrieval noise (1-20 documents), visual ambiguity (Gaussian and motion blur, low-resource crops) and cross-modal conflict with counterfactual flip pairs. Instead of only measuring degradation, we ask how models combine the two modalities. From ideal Bayesian cue combination we derive a testable prediction that yields formal definitions of Knowledge Inertia (text over-weighted relative to the model's own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse), and we estimate the weights with a measurement-error-corrected regression whose recovery of known weights we verify. A counterfactual flip decomposition separates modality bias from concept priors, and a Grounding Illusion Score measures how much clean accuracy is not grounded in the image. We evaluate 4 open models on one frozen, seeded evaluation split of 2,000 GIB-200K items. All models are accurate on clean inputs (92.5%-94.2%) but adverse accuracy falls to 41.3%-59.9%. The two LLaVA models over-weight the text (Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322), whereas InternVL3 favours the image (w_T/w_I = 0.680); between 34.8% and 71.4% of the clean answers that are correct are abandoned when the document lies. A training-free consistency check that compares the answer with and without retrieval trades coverage for accuracy under misleading documents, while falling back to the image fails when the image is heavily degraded. All per-instance outputs, code, and an audit that recomputes every reported open-model number are released.
blocks.zh: 被检索到的视觉语言模型(VLM)从两个证据来源中解答,每个证据都可能失败:被检索到的文本可能错误或吵闹,图像也可能被退化或相矛盾. 我们引入了由COCO和Visual Genome所制造的GIB-200K,20万个图像问题项目,每个项目都扩展为可控的压力条件:硬负回取噪(1-20个文档),视觉模糊(Gausian and Movement 模糊,低资源收成)和与反事实翻转对对的交叉模式冲突. 我们不但要衡量退化,还要问模型如何将两种模式结合起来。 从理想的贝叶斯提示组合中,我们得出了一种可测试的预测,该预测得出了"知识内线"(相对于模型自身图像证据的文本超重)和"感官捕捉"(反相)的正式定义,我们用一个测量-过重校正的回归来估计重量,我们验证了这些回归的已知重量的恢复。 反事实翻转分解将模式偏差与概念前缀区分开来,并用地平线幻觉分数来测量图像中有多少干净的精度没有根基. 我们评价一个冷冻的4个开放式模型, 种子评价分为2 000个GIB-200K项目。 所有模型在清洁输入上都是准确的(92.5%-94.2%),但反准确率下降到41.3%-59.9%. LLaVA的两个模型超重了文本(Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229和1.322),而InternVL3偏好图像(w_T/w_I = 0.680);在文档存在时,34.8%到71.4%的正确答案被废弃. 无培训一致性检查,将答案与不检索的答案进行比较,在误导性文件下进行准确性覆盖,而当图像严重退化时,返回图像失败。 发布所有每一次输入输出,代码,以及重新计算每个已报告的开放型号的审计.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision–language models increasingly answer questions about images with the help of retrieved text: product pages, encyclopedia entries, captions of similar photographs [ 12 , 15 ] . Both sources fail in practice. Retrieval returns near-misses that look relevant but are wrong; images are blurred, cropped or badly lit; and sometimes the two simply disagree. Existing hallucination benchmarks mostly isolate one failure source, either object hallucination in captions [ 17 , 13 ] or visual illusions and language priors [ 5 , 20 ] , and robustness suites study image corruptions without retrieval [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型越来越多地在检索文本的帮助下解答有关图像的问题:产品页,百科全书条目,类似照片的字幕[12,15]. 这两个来源实际上都失败了。 检索返回看起来相关但错误的近似缺失;图像模糊、裁剪或照明严重;有时两者完全不一致。 现有的幻觉基准大多孤立了一个故障源,要么在标题[17,13]中标注物体幻觉,要么是视觉幻觉和语言前传[5,20],强健的套房研究图像腐败而不检索[7].

blocks.en: It is no surprise that models get worse when evidence is corrupted, and humans do too. The real question is whether a model weighs its two sources of evidence sensibly. An image the model can barely see should lose to a clear document, and a clear image should not lose to a document that merely asserts the opposite. Accuracy curves cannot tell these cases apart, so we compare models with a normative reference: the ideal observer of perceptual cue combination [ 2 ] , which combines conditionally independent cues by adding their log-likelihood ratios. This gives a falsifiable prediction for every model and every item, and lets us define the two failure modes that earlier work named only informally: Knowledge Inertia (text evidence over-weighted relative to the model’s own image evidence) and Sensory Capture (the reverse).
blocks.zh: 当证据被破坏,人类也这样做时,模特们会变得更糟,这并不奇怪。 真正的问题是模型是否明智地权衡了它的两个证据来源. 模型几乎看不到的图像应输给清晰的文档,清晰的图像不应输给仅仅声称相反的文件。 准确性曲线无法将这些情况区分开来,所以我们比较模型与规范的参考: 透视提示组合的理想观察者[2],通过增加它们的对数率来结合有条件的独立提示. 这为每个模型和每个项目提供了一种可伪造的预测,让我们来定义之前仅非正式命名的两种失败模式: Knowledge Inertia(文本证据相对于模型本身的图像证据过于加权)和感官捕获(反之).

blocks.en: Two confounds can make naive conflict tests misleading. First, a model that answers with the text’s claim may not be following the text at all and may just prefer that concept whatever the modality; a counterfactual flip of the conflict separates the two. Second, clean accuracy can be high because the gold document contains the answer; we measure how much of it survives when the document lies.
blocks.zh: 两个困惑会使天真的冲突测试产生误导。 首先,一种用案文的主张作答的模式可能根本不遵循案文,而可能只是倾向于这一概念,不管采用何种方式;冲突的一个反事实翻转将两者分开。 第二,干净的准确度可以很高,因为金色的文档包含了答案;我们测量了其中有多少在文档存在时存活.

blocks.en: Findings. On a frozen 2,000-item split, four open models lose a large part of their clean accuracy under stress, with retrieval noise as the steepest axis (Section 6). Their failure modes differ: LLaVA-1.6 and LLaVA-0.5B over-weight the text relative to their own image evidence (Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322), InternVL3 is image-biased (w_T/w_I = 0.680) and Qwen2-VL weighs the two cues almost equally (w_T/w_I = 0.937). The flip decomposition shows that a substantial share of apparent text-following is a concept prior rather than modality bias, and that between 34.8% and 71.4% of correct clean answers are not grounded in the image. A cheap consistency check helps when documents mislead but hurts when the image is degraded (Section 7).
blocks.zh: 发现。 在冰冻的2 000件碎块上,四个开放型号在压力下失去了大部分干净的精度,回收噪声是最陡峭的轴心(第6节)。 它们的失败模式不同:LLaVA-1.6和LLaVA-0.5B相对于自己的图像证据(Knowledge Inertia, w_T/w_I=1.229和1.322),InternVL3具有图像偏差(w_T/w_I=0.680),Qune2-VL对两个提示的重量几乎相等(w_T/w_I=0.937)。 翻转分解显示,大量明显的文字跟随是先行概念,而不是模式偏差,34.8%到71.4%的正确干净答案不以图像为基础. 当文档被误导时, 廉价的一致性检查会有所帮助, 当图像退化时, 会很痛( 第7节) 。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Hallucination in VLMs. CHAIR [ 17 ] counts mentioned objects that are absent from the image; POPE [ 13 ] probes object presence with yes/no questions, including adversarially chosen absent objects. MMHal-Bench [ 18 ] , HallusionBench [ 5 ] and HaloQuest [ 20 ] broaden the question types. None of them varies retrieved text, image quality and image–text conflict on the same items. We reuse CHAIR and POPE inside our stress conditions.
blocks.zh: VLMs中的幻觉. CHAIR [17] 计数了图像中缺失的物体; POPE [13] 探测器中包含有是/无问题的物体存在,包括对抗性选择的缺席物体. MMHal-Bench [18], Hallusion Bench [5]和HaloQuest [20] 拓宽了问题类型. 在同一项目上,它们都没有更改检索到的文本、图像质量和图像-文本冲突。 我们在压力条件下重用总统和警察

blocks.en: Knowledge conflicts. For text-only QA, models prefer either memorised knowledge or context depending on the setting [ 16 , 21 ] . ReFinD [ 11 ] measures how retrieved context changes token likelihoods. We bring these questions to the image–text setting, where the ’parametric’ side is replaced by visual evidence whose reliability we can control.
blocks.zh: 知识冲突. 对于只使用文本的QA,模型更倾向于根据设置[16,21]而记下来的知识或上下文. ReFinD [11] 测量检索到的上下文如何改变符号概率. 我们把这些问题带到图像 - 文本设置上, 即`参数 ' 一方被视觉证据所取代,

blocks.en: Robustness and cue integration. Corruption benchmarks [ 7 ] measure accuracy under blur and noise. Human multisensory integration is close to the statistically optimal combination of cues weighted by their reliability [ 2 ] ; we take that ideal observer as the normative reference for VLMs. Attention weights are not explanations [ 9 ] ; we treat them only as a correlational signature and test that correlation.
blocks.zh: 强健与提示整合. 腐败基准[7]在模糊和噪音下衡量准确性。 人类的多感融合接近于统计学上的最佳组合,以它们的可靠性加权[2];我们把这种理想的观察者作为VLM的规范参考. 注意权重不是解释[9];我们只把它们当作一种相关签名,并检验这种相关。

blocks.en: 3 The GIB-200K Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 GIB- 200K 基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Items
blocks.zh: 3.1 项目

blocks.en: Every item is an image from COCO [ 14 ] with a question whose answer comes from a closed vocabulary, so free-form answers can be scored deterministically without an LLM judge. Object questions (’What animal is shown in the image?’) use eleven COCO category groups and are created only when exactly one category of the group is annotated and its largest instance covers at least 4% of the image. Attribute questions (’What color is the bus?’) use Visual Genome [ 10 ] objects whose name is unique in the image and that carry exactly one of eleven colours. Relation questions use eight spatial predicates from Visual Genome and left/right relations computed from COCO boxes. Visual Genome is linked to COCO through its ‘coco_id‘ field. The 200,000 items are split evenly across the three types; an image carries up to four items. They come from COCO train2017 and from all that the 5,000 val2017 images allow (Section 5).
blocks.zh: 每个项目都是来自COCO[14]的图像,有一个问题,其答案来自一个封闭的词汇,因此自由形式答案可以在没有LLM判断器的情况下确定得分. 物体问题( ' 图像中显示的是什么动物? ' )使用11个COCO类别组,并且只有当一个类别组被附加说明,其最大实例至少覆盖图像的4%时才会产生。 属性问题( ' 总线是什么颜色? ' ) 使用视觉基因组[ 10] 物体,其名称在图像中是独一无二的,并且完全带有11种颜色之一。 关系问题使用来自视觉基因组的8个空间上游和从COCO框计算的左/右关系. 视觉基因组通过其“coco_id”领域与COCO相连。 这20万件物品在三种类型之间分布均匀;一幅图像携带多达4件物品. 它们来自2017年COCO列车,以及所有5000 val2017图像允许的(第5节).

blocks.en: 3.2 Retrieved documents and hard negatives
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 已获取文档和硬底片

blocks.en: The gold document is a COCO caption that mentions the answer (or a template sentence). Every hard negative is the gold document with its answer slot replaced by a sibling: another member of the same category group ranked by COCO co-occurrence, the perceptually nearest colours, or the antonym predicate first (’on’ ↔ \leftrightarrow ’under’). So the distractors are semantically close but factually wrong, and they differ from the gold document only in the claim.
blocks.zh: 金色文档是一个COCO标题,其中提到了答案(或模板句子). 每个硬底是金色文件,其答录槽被一个兄弟所取代:同一个类别组的另一成员由COCO co-currency、近视颜色、或最先( ' 在 ' > 左右旋 ' under ' )排列。 因此,分散注意力者在本质上是接近但事实上是错误的,他们仅在索赔中就与黄金文件不同.

blocks.en: 3.3 Stress conditions
blocks.zh: 3.3 压力状况

blocks.en: Table 1: Stress conditions per item. Levels evaluated in this paper (all fixed before any model was run); the benchmark also defines the full level set given in brackets.
blocks.zh: 表1:每个项目的压力状况。 本文件评价的级别(在运行任何模型之前全部固定);基准还界定了括号内的全部级别。

blocks.en: Images are standardised to 640 px on the longer side before degradation, so a given σ \sigma means the same on every photograph; degraded images are re-rendered deterministically and need not be stored. The blur conditions are asked without documents, so they measure perception; blur with a correct document is a separate condition that probes Sensory Capture.
blocks.zh: 图像在退化前标准化为640px在更长的一侧,所以给定的\\sigma在每张照片上都表示相同;退化的图像被重新确定,不需要存储. 模糊的条件在没有文档的情况下被问到,所以它们测量知觉;与正确文档的模糊是探测感官捕捉的单独条件.

blocks.en: 3.4 Probes
blocks.zh: 3.4 探测器

blocks.en: Every condition is asked as a free-form question (’Answer the question using a single word or phrase.’) and as a multiple-choice question over a fixed set of five options per item (two for left/right questions). For conflict items, a binary A/B probe offers the image’s answer and the text’s claim, in both option orders. POPE yes/no probes (one present and one adversarially chosen absent object) and caption probes for CHAIR are run on every image condition (caption probes on a random tenth of the items per condition). All models, open and closed, receive byte-identical prompts (Appendix E).
blocks.zh: 每个条件都作为一个自由形式的问题( ' 用一个单词或短语回答问题. ' )和一个多选择问题,每个项目有一套固定的五个选项(左/右问题两个选项)。 对于冲突项目,一个二进制A/B探测器在两种选择顺序中都给出图像的答案和文本的主张. POPE是/没有探测器(一个在现场,一个在外选择的对抗性物体)和CHAIR的字幕探测器运行在每一个图像条件上(每个条件的随机十分之一的封装探测器). 所有型号,开放和关闭,都收到字节-同义提示(Appendix E).

blocks.en: 3.5 Counterfactual flip pairs and the evaluation split
blocks.zh: 3.5 反事实翻转对对和评价分开

blocks.en: Items are matched at build time so that item i (image shows A, document claims B) has a partner j (image shows B, document claims A). Running every model on all 200,000 items was beyond our compute budget, so we froze one seeded split of 2,000 items (the item list and its checksum are released) and the reduced level set of Table 1 ; every model answers all of it. Confidence intervals resample images, so items that share an image are never treated as independent.
blocks.zh: 项目在构建时进行匹配,使项目i(图像显示A,文件索赔B)有一个伙伴j(图像显示B,文件索赔A)。 运行所有20万项的每个模型都超出了我们的计算预算,因此我们冻结了2,000项的种子分拆(项目清单及其校验和已经公布)和减少的表1;每个模型都回答了所有问题。 信任间隔重现图像,因此共享图像的项目从不被视为独立.

blocks.en: 4 Measuring Grounding
blocks.zh: 4 测量地面

blocks.en: All metrics are functions of a released per-instance table, and all confidence intervals are 95% percentile intervals of an image-cluster bootstrap [ 1 ] (all queries of all items of an image are resampled together).
blocks.zh: 所有度量衡都是一个释放的每层表格的函数,所有置信间隔都是95%的图像集群靴子[1]的间隔(所有对图像所有项目的查询都一起重印).

blocks.en: 4.1 Accuracy, calibration and robustness
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 准确性、校准性和稳健性

blocks.en: Free-form answers are mapped to the first vocabulary term they mention (with synonyms and plurals). Adverse accuracy averages the retrieval, visual and conflict axes with equal weight. Following a robustness coefficient, we penalise confident errors with the expected calibration error [ 6 ] of the multiple-choice probe on adverse conditions (the uncertainty error UE):

blocks.en: 4.7 Attention profiles

blocks.en: For open models we record, at the last prompt token of every layer, the share of attention on image tokens relative to image plus following text tokens (tokens before the image, which often act as attention sinks, are excluded). The attention shift is the paired per-layer difference between the clean and conflict versions of the same item, whose prompts differ only in the claimed answer. We report the full profile instead of a layer average, and test whether a low visual share predicts that the answer follows the text (AUROC).
blocks.zh: 对于开放式的模型,我们记录在每一层的最后一个即时指示符上,图像指示符相对于图像的注意力份额,加上文字指示符之后的注意份额(图像前的键,常作为注意力汇作用,被排除在外). 注意力转移是同一物品的清洁版本和冲突版本之间每层的配对差异,其提示仅在声称的答案中有所不同. 我们报告完整的剖面图,而不是一层平均值,并测试低视觉份额是否预测答案跟随文本(AUROC).

blocks.en: 4.8 Failure taxonomy
blocks.zh: 4.8 失败分类

blocks.en: A wrong free-form answer is classified by what it matches: Knowledge Inertia if it repeats a wrong claim from a document; Sensory Capture if the documents contained the correct answer but the model gave a different valid answer; Reasoning Collapse if it is off-vocabulary or matches neither image nor documents; Perceptual Error if no document was shown. These are deterministic rules decided by what the answer matches; we did not validate them against human labels (Section Limitations).
blocks.zh: 错误的自由形式答案按匹配的分类: Knowledge Inertia,如果它重复了文档中的错误说法; Sensory Captain,如果文档中包含正确的答案,但模型给出了不同的有效答案; 如果它离场或既不匹配图像,也不匹配文档,则解释崩溃; 如果没有显示文档,则理解错误。 这些都是由答案匹配而决定的决定性规则;我们并没有对照人类的标签来验证这些规则(节限制)。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate 4 open models: LLaVA-1.6-Mistral-7B [ 15 ] , Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct [ 19 ] , InternVL3-8B [ 22 ] and LLaVA-Interleave-Qwen-0.5B (Hugging Face ids and commit hashes in Appendix F). They run through Hugging Face transformers with greedy decoding (at most 10 new tokens for answers, 48 for captions). All models see the same items, images, documents and prompts. The three 7–8B models run with 4-bit NF4 weight quantisation (bfloat16 compute); the 0.5B model runs unquantised. We did not run an unquantised comparison of the larger models, so absolute numbers may differ from full-precision inference; all comparisons between conditions are within one model. The whole evaluation used one 24 GB RTX 4090, with two runs sharing the GPU.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评价4个开放型号:LLaVA-1.6-Mistral-7B[15],Qun2-VL-7B-指示[19],InternVL3-8B[22]和LLaVA-Interleave-Qun-0.5B (附录F中的缩写为 " 面部识别码 " 和 " 承诺散列 " )。 他们通过Hugging Face变压器进行贪婪的解码(最多10个新的代号用于回答,48个用于标题). 所有模型都能看到相同的项目,图像,文档和提示. 3台7-8B型机车运行时采用4位NF4重量量化(bfloat16 compute);0.5B型机车运行时采用无量化. 我们并没有对较大的模型进行无量化的比较,因此绝对数字可能不同于完全精确的推论;所有条件的比较都是在一个模型之内的. 整个评价使用1台24GB RTX 4090,两台运行共享GPU.

blocks.en: Efficient inference. Every query on an image shares the image prefix, which is encoded once and reused through the key–value cache; probe distributions are read from a single next-token distribution. At the start of each run the cached computation is checked against a plain forward pass (and falls back automatically if a model family behaves differently).

blocks.zh: 图3:95%CI的Cue-组合重量。 恒星是理想的观察者(1,1);在对角超重文本(英语:Knowledge Inertia)上方的点,在它的下方是图像(Sensory Capture).

blocks.en: When the document asserts a sibling of the image’s answer, LLaVA-1.6 and LLaVA-0.5B are text-biased (Trust Index 3.724 and 2.705), whereas InternVL3 and Qwen2-VL are image-biased (0.198 and 0.576); in every case the 95% interval excludes 1. The ideal-observer test (Table 4 , Figure 3 ) shows that the Trust Index alone does not tell the whole story: no model reaches the ideal weights of 1 for both cues (w_I between 0.586 and 0.895, w_T between 0.609 and 0.777). Relative to its own image evidence, LLaVA-1.6 and LLaVA-0.5B over-weight the text (w_T/w_I = 1.229 and 1.322: Knowledge Inertia), InternVL3 under-weights it (w_T/w_I = 0.680: Sensory Capture) and Qwen2-VL is nearly balanced (w_T/w_I = 0.937, a small Sensory Capture).
blocks.zh: 当文件声称图像的答案为兄弟时,LLaVA-1.6和LLaVA-0.5B是文本偏差的(信任指数3.724和2.705),而InternVL3和Qun2-VL是图像偏差的(0.198和0.576);在每一种情况下,95%的间隔都排除了文本偏差。 1. 理想-观察者测试(表4,图3)表明,仅信托指数并不能说明整个情况:没有一种模型达到两个提示1的理想权重(w_I在0.586至0.895之间,w_T在0.609至0.777之间)。 相对于其自身的图像证据,LLaVA-1.6和LLaVA-0.5B超重文本(w_T/w_I=1.229和1.322:Knowledge Inertia),InternVL3低重文本(w_T/w_I=0.680:感官捕捉)和Qwen2-VL接近平衡(w_T/w_I=0.937,一个小感官捕捉).

blocks.en: 6.2 Modality bias or concept prior?
blocks.zh: 6.2 模式偏向或概念先行?

blocks.en: Table 5: Counterfactual flip decomposition (share of flip pairs).
blocks.zh: 表5:反事实翻转分解(翻转对分).

blocks.en: A model that repeats the text’s claim may simply prefer that concept. The flip pairs separate the cases (Table 5 ). LLaVA-0.5B is text-consistent on 56.5% of the pairs and image-consistent on only 15.6%; InternVL3 shows the reverse (15.2% text-consistent, 52.0% image-consistent). Concept priors are not negligible for any model: they account for 32.8% (InternVL3), 35.0% (Qwen2-VL), 27.9% (LLaVA-0.5B) and 40.6% (LLaVA-1.6) of the pairs, and for LLaVA-1.6 they are as common as text-following (40.9%). A single-direction conflict test would have counted all of these as text-following.
blocks.zh: 重复案文要求的模式可能只是倾向于这一概念。 翻转的对子将案件分开(表5). LLaVA-0.5B在56.5%的对子上与文字一致,只有15.6%的图像一致;InternVL3显示相反(15.2%的文本一致,52.0%的图像一致). 对于任何型号来说,概念前科都是不可忽略的:它们占32.8%(InternVL3)、35.0%(Qun2-VL)、27.9%(LLaVA-05B)和40.6%(LLaVA-1.6),对于LLaVA-1.6来说,它们与文本跟踪一样常见(40.9%)。 单向冲突测试会将这些都算作文字跟踪。

blocks.en: 6.3 The grounding illusion
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 地面上的幻觉

blocks.en: Between 34.8% (InternVL3) and 71.4% (LLaVA-0.5B) of the clean answers that are correct are abandoned when the document lies (Grounding Illusion Score, Table 2 ; Qwen2-VL 47.9%, LLaVA-1.6 62.3%). The illusion gap, clean accuracy minus accuracy that survives the conflict, is 39.2% for InternVL3, 50.7% for Qwen2-VL, 62.1% for LLaVA-1.6 and 69.1% for LLaVA-0.5B: a large share of what looks like grounded accuracy on clean inputs is actually accuracy supplied by the document. We ran no human baseline, so we cannot say how this compares with people.
blocks.zh: 正确答案的34.8%(InternVL3)和71.4%(LLaVA-0.5B)在文件存在时被放弃(Grounding Illusion Score,表2;Qune2-VL 47.9%,LLaVA-1.6 62.3%)。 错觉差距,干净精度减去冲突遗留下来的精度,是39.2%的InternVL3,50.7%的Quen2-VL,62.1%的LLaVA-1.6和69.1%的LLaVA-05B:文件实际提供的精度在清洁输入上看起来像是有根据的精度。 我们没有利用人类的基线,因此我们不能说这与人相比有什么不同。

blocks.en: A closed model as reference. We also ran Gemini 3.8 Flash through its API on a nested 500-item subset of the same split, on the conflict axis only and with free-form answers (the API exposes no token probabilities, so R, the Trust Index and calibration are not defined for it). It is accurate on clean inputs (96.8%) but drops to 60.2% when the document contradicts the image: the illusion gap is 36.8%, the Grounding Illusion Score 34.1%, and 33.8% of its free-form answers follow the false text. The grounding illusion is therefore not specific to open models. The run is not reproducible (API, temperature 0, no seed) and is kept out of the four-model tables above.
blocks.zh: 闭合模型作为参考. 我们还通过它的API运行双子座3.8 Flash,运行在同一个分裂的嵌套500项子集上,只运行在冲突轴上,并且有自由格式的答案(API没有显示任何符号概率,所以R,信任指数和校准没有为此定义). 在干净输入(96.8 %)上是准确的,但在文档与图像相矛盾时则下降到60.2%:幻觉差距为36.8%,"地面幻觉分数"为34.1%,其自由形式的回答有33.8%跟随虚假文本. 因此,地面幻觉并不专门针对开放模型。 跑步是不可复制的(API,温度0,无种子),并且被保留在以上四个型号表之外.

blocks.en: 6.4 Attention, failure modes and contamination
blocks.zh: 6.4 注意、故障模式和污染

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Visual share of attention per layer for the same images with a correct vs. a misleading document (solid), and for conflict items split by whether the answer followed the text (dotted).
blocks.zh: 图4:对正确对误导文档(固件)的相同图像,以及按答案是否跟随文本划分的冲突项目(虚构),每层可视化的注意力份额.

blocks.en: Averaged over layers, the paired attention shift is small (-0.012 for InternVL3, -0.013 for Qwen2-VL, -0.006 for LLaVA-1.6, 0.005 for LLaVA-0.5B), and the profile explains why: the shift is concentrated in the last third of the layers (Table 7 in the Appendix, Figure 4 ). In InternVL3, Qwen2-VL and, slightly, LLaVA-1.6 the visual share rises when the document is misleading, i.e. these models look at the image more when the sources disagree. Within conflict items, a low visual share is associated with following the text for every model (AUROC in Table 7 ). Attention is correlational and we draw no causal conclusion from it.
blocks.zh: 平均分层,对联的注意力转移较小(Wen2-VL为-0.012,Qwen2-VL为-0.013,LLaVA-1.6为-0.006,LLaVA-05B为0.005),剖面说明为何:这种转移集中在各层的最后三分之一(附录中表7,图4)。 在InternVL3,Qune2-VL和略微的LLaVA-1.6中,视觉份额在文档误导时会上升,即当来源有分歧时,这些模型会更多地看图像. 在冲突项目中,低视距份额与每个模型的文本相同(表7中的AUROC)。 注意是相互关联的,我们没有从中得出任何因果关系的结论。

blocks.en: The failure taxonomy (Table 8 , Appendix) separates what goes wrong where. Under retrieval noise and conflict, wrong answers are almost always claims copied from a document (Knowledge Inertia), whereas under blur without documents they are Perceptual Errors or Reasoning Collapse; Sensory Capture is rare. We find no measurable dependence on whether the source image is in COCO train2017 or val2017 (only 83 val2017 items, so the test has limited power): the differences in Table 10 (Appendix) have confidence intervals that include zero for every model.
blocks.zh: 故障分类法(表8,附录)将哪里出错区分开来. 在检索噪音和冲突下,错误的答案几乎总是从文件(Knowledge Inertia)中复制出来,而在模糊的没有文件的情况下,它们是感官错误或理性崩溃;感官捕获是罕见的。 我们发现没有可以衡量的依赖源图像是COCO列车2017还是val2017(只有83个val2017项目,所以测试的功率有限):表10(附录)中的差异具有包含每个型号0的置信间隔.

Retrieval noise and conflict: the models copy a wrong claim from a document; blur and crop: the image no longer determines the answer. The report’s gallery lists, per condition, the first four items (by id) that at least one model answered correctly on the clean image but not under stress; we show two per condition, preferring those that fool most models (not a random sample).

blocks.en: 7 From Diagnosis to Mitigation
blocks.zh: 7 从诊断到缓解

blocks.en: Because every question is also asked without documents, a deployable check comes at no extra cost: if the answer changes when the documents are removed, the documents are suspect. We evaluate three training-free policies (abstain, fall back to the image-only answer, or keep the more confident answer) in three settings: where documents lie, where they are right but the image is degraded, and on clean inputs (Table 6 and Appendix Table 9 ).
blocks.zh: 因为每个问题也是在没有文件的情况下被问到的,所以一个可部署的检查不产生额外费用:如果文件被移除时答案会改变,那么文件是可疑的. 我们评价三种无培训政策(吸收、回到只反映图像的答案,或保持更自信的答案),在三种情况下:文件存放的地方、文件正确但图像退化的地方、以及干净的投入(表6和附录表9)。

blocks.en: Table 6: Training-free consistency gate: change in accuracy when the answer with documents disagrees with the image-only answer ( Δ \Delta vs. no gate; 95% CI).
blocks.zh: 表6:无训练一致性门:当与文档的答案与只图像的答案不一致时,精度变化(QQ\Delta vs. no gate;95% CI).

blocks.en: The check behaves as a trade-off (Table 6 ). Where the documents mislead (conflict, k = 20), abstaining when the two answers disagree gives a clearly higher selective accuracy than the ungated model, at the price of coverage, and falling back to the image-only answer raises accuracy for all models. When the document is correct but the image is heavily blurred, the same fallback is harmful: it replaces mostly right answers with answers from an image the model cannot read, and abstention discards about half of the questions. So the check works as a monitoring signal for retrieval-augmented systems with good images, and not as a universal fix.
blocks.zh: 检查表现为权衡(表6). 当文档误导(冲突,k = 20)时,当两个答案不一致时弃权,以覆盖价格给定的模型明显更高的选择性精度,回到只图像的答案会提高所有模型的精度. 当文档正确但图像严重模糊时,同样的倒置是有害的:它用模型无法读取的图像的答案来取代大多数正确的答案,弃权弃置大约一半的问题. 因此,检查工作是作为具有良好图像的检索增强系统的监测信号,而不是作为通用的固定.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Four open VLMs, evaluated on the same 2,000 items under retrieval noise, blur and conflict, do not weigh text and image alike: two over-weight the text, one favours the image, and none matches the ideal observer. Accuracy under stress is far below clean accuracy, retrieval noise is the steepest axis, and a considerable part of apparent text-following is a concept prior. We release the benchmark, the frozen split, all per-instance predictions and an audit that recomputes every open-model number in this paper.
blocks.zh: 4个开放的VLM,在检索噪声下在相同的2000个项目上评价,模糊不清和冲突,对文本和图像不作同等的权衡:两个超重文本,一个偏好图像,没有哪个与理想的观察者匹配. 压力下的精确度远低于干净的精确度,检索噪声是最陡峭的轴线,相当一部分明显的文字跟随是先有的概念. 我们发布基准,冻结的拆分,所有每一次的预言,以及一份对本文中每个开放型号进行重算的审计.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We evaluate a seeded 2,000-item split of the 200,000 items with a reduced level set, and four open models, three of them in 4-bit quantisation without a full-precision comparison; results on the full benchmark, on larger models and on closed models other than the one reference run (a single closed model, conflict axis only, 500 items) may differ. We ran no human baseline and did not validate the failure taxonomy against human labels. Closed answer vocabularies make scoring exact but restrict the question types, and Visual Genome attributes are noisy. Attention is a correlational signal. The train/val split is a proxy for exposure to COCO during instruction tuning, not proof of it; post-cutoff images (supported by the builder) would be a stronger control.
blocks.zh: 我们评价20万件物品中一个种子2000项的分数,其水平集减少,四个开放型号,其中三个在4位的量化中,没有完全精确的比较;对于全部基准,更大的型号以及除一个参考运行以外的封闭型号(一个单一封闭型号,只有冲突轴,500项)的结果可能有所不同. 我们没有进行人类基线调查,也没有验证人类标签上的失败分类。 闭合的解答词汇使评分准确但限制问题类型,视觉基因组属性很吵. 注意是一个相关信号。 列车/val拆分是指示调谐时接触COCO的代称,而不是证明;停产后图像(由建造者支持)将是更强的控制.
